events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when MTV actually played music videos? It all started on this day in 1981 with a truly iconic first track.

events.title: Woodstock Festival took place
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Forty-nine years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music and legacy continue to shake the world.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever, what's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, Dr. No, which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 since Dr. No premiered on this day in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, legendary comedian and actor, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many laughs.
